title: “玩托邦”中的性别实践：中国女玩家对游戏女性角色认知调研
titleEn: Gender Practice in Game Utopia: Chinese Female Gamers’ Perception of Female Game Characters
subtitle: 游戏文化专题调研小组作业
description: 以多款电子游戏为研究案例，从女性玩家视角分析游戏女性角色塑造、性别叙事设计，梳理玩家对游戏女性形象的真实看法与感受。
descriptionEn: Taking various video games as research cases, analyze the design of female game characters and gender narrative from female gamers’ perspective, and sort out players’ real opinions on female game images.
concept: 聚焦游戏媒介中的性别表达议题，对比多款游戏里女性角色的形象、剧情差异，探究女性玩家群体的体验反馈，讨论游戏行业性别叙事现状。
conceptEn: Focus on gender expression in games, compare differences of female characters across multiple games, explore feedback from female players and discuss current gender narrative situation in gaming industry.
roleDetail: 小组作业，敲定调研选题，搜集整理文献与游戏案例素材，完成报告配图整理与整体排版。
roleDetailEn: Group assignment. Confirmed research topic, collected literature and game case materials, sorted pictures and unified the layout of the report.
